title: Streak Metric2 Rolling 7-Day Value Average
dataSources: Life score (`lifeos:score`), quests / tasks (`quest:task`), habit streaks (`streak:status`), life achievements (`achievement:life`), household leaderboard (`household:leaderboard`), plus every other `index=personal` sourcetype as input.
app: The parody-the-enterprise meta layer — a Personal NOC (house-health wall), Personal SOC (entry / impossible-travel), Personal SRE (SLOs on your own habits), and a gamification layer (XP, achievements, streaks, household leaderboards) — all computed in Splunk over `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=streak:metric2 value=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(value) as daily_avg by _time
| streamstats window=7 avg(daily_avg) as rolling_7d
| sort _time
description: Tracks a seven-day rolling average of daily value for streak metric2 (2) data.
value: Rolling averages highlight gradual drift without overreacting to one-off days.
implementation: Compute daily average `value` then a seven-day rolling mean for streak metric2 (2) events.
visualization: Line chart of daily and rolling average value.
grandmaExplanation: It rates the smoothed week-long trend in your value from streak metric2 (2).
